title: Visitors
description: How many people use betula.app, estimated from Traefik's access log (7 days). Provisioned from deploy/config/monitoring/grafana/dashboards - edit there.

panels.title: Visitors
panels.description: Browsers (address + user agent) that started the app in the selected range.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host, ua) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` |= `/api/status` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | path=`/api/status` | ua!~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|preview|facebookexternalhit|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|scan|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | ua!=`` | host!~`(66\.249|74\.125|192\.178)\..*` [$__range])))

panels.title: Visitors, last 24 h
panels.description: Browsers that started the app in the 24 hours up to now, whatever the range.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host, ua) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` |= `/api/status` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | path=`/api/status` | ua!~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|preview|facebookexternalhit|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|scan|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | ua!=`` | host!~`(66\.249|74\.125|192\.178)\..*` [24h])))

panels.title: App starts
panels.description: Every visit, returning ones too (one /api/status each).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` |= `/api/status` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | path=`/api/status` | ua!~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|preview|facebookexternalhit|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|scan|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | ua!=`` | host!~`(66\.249|74\.125|192\.178)\..*` [$__range]))

panels.title: Calendar subscribers
panels.description: Clients (address + user agent) that fetched a calendar feed (/calendar/<code>.ics) in the range - calendar apps poll it, so each subscription shows up.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host, ua) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` |= `calendar/` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | path=~`(/en)?/calendar/.*` | status=~`2..|304` [$__range])))

options.content:
A **visitor** is one browser that started the app: `boot.js` asks `/api/status` (with `cache: no-store`) on every visit, returning ones too. Crawlers mostly fetch HTML only; the ones that run the app (Google's renderer) are filtered by user agent and by Google's address ranges. A browser is counted by address + user agent, never shown.

- **Too high:** a phone that changes its address counts again; the owner's own devices and tests are in it.
- **Too low:** several people behind one address with the same browser count once (a flat, a university network). BTU eduroam blocks the name.
- **Window:** Traefik's access log stays 7 days in Loki (`loki.yml`, privacy notice). Longer ranges show nothing more.

panels.title: Visitors, rolling 24 h
panels.description: At each point: browsers that started the app in the 24 hours before it.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host, ua) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` |= `/api/status` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | path=`/api/status` | ua!~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|preview|facebookexternalhit|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|scan|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | ua!=`` | host!~`(66\.249|74\.125|192\.178)\..*` [1d])))

panels.title: Visitors per hour
panels.description: Browsers that started the app in each hour. Shows when people use Betula.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host, ua) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` |= `/api/status` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | path=`/api/status` | ua!~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|preview|facebookexternalhit|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|scan|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | ua!=`` | host!~`(66\.249|74\.125|192\.178)\..*` [1h])))

panels.title: Device
panels.description: Visitors in the range by user agent: Phone (Mobile/iPhone/Android), Tablet (iPad), Desktop.

targets.expr: count by (device) (sum by (device, host, ua) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` |= `/api/status` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | path=`/api/status` | ua!~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|preview|facebookexternalhit|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|scan|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | ua!=`` | host!~`(66\.249|74\.125|192\.178)\..*` | label_format device=`{{ if or (contains "Mobile" .ua) (contains "iPhone" .ua) (contains "Android" .ua) }}Phone{{ else if contains "iPad" .ua }}Tablet{{ else }}Desktop{{ end }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Browser
panels.description: Visitors in the range by browser, read from the user agent.

targets.expr: count by (browser) (sum by (browser, host, ua) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` |= `/api/status` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | path=`/api/status` | ua!~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|preview|facebookexternalhit|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|scan|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | ua!=`` | host!~`(66\.249|74\.125|192\.178)\..*` | label_format browser=`{{ if contains "Firefox" .ua }}Firefox{{ else if contains "Edg/" .ua }}Edge{{ else if contains "OPR/" .ua }}Opera{{ else if contains "SamsungBrowser" .ua }}Samsung{{ else if contains "Chrome" .ua }}Chrome{{ else if contains "CriOS" .ua }}Chrome{{ else if contains "Safari" .ua }}Safari{{ else }}other{{ end }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Pages people load
panels.description: Successful requests without crawlers, by the first part of the path (/en is folded in); assets, API, cards and feeds left out. Counts page loads, not visitors: the app itself navigates without asking the server for most pages.

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (page) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` != `Googlebot` != `Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P` !~ `"RequestPath":"/(pkg|assets|cards)/` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | ua!~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|preview|facebookexternalhit|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|scan|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | ua!=`` | host!~`(66\.249|74\.125|192\.178)\..*` | status=~`2..|304` | path!~`/(pkg|assets|api|sw\.js|favicon|apple-touch|manifest|cards|robots|sitemap|livez|healthz|calendar|en/calendar).*` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^(/en)?(/[a-z]*)?.*" .path "${2}" }}` | page!=`` [$__range])))

panels.title: Requests: Google, other crawlers, everything else
panels.description: All requests to betula.app. "Everything else" is people plus scanners and tools without a crawler user agent.

targets.expr: sum by (who) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | label_format who=`{{ $u := lower .ua }}{{ if or (contains "googlebot" $u) (contains "nexus 5x build/mmb29p" $u) (hasPrefix "66.249." .host) }}Google{{ else if or (contains "bot" $u) (contains "crawl" $u) (contains "spider" $u) }}other crawlers{{ else }}everything else{{ end }}` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Crawlers by name
panels.description: Requests in the range by crawler (bot/crawler/spider in the user agent; Google's renderer sends a Nexus 5X agent without the word).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (crawler) (count_over_time({service="edge_traefik"} |= `"RequestHost":"betula.app"` | json host="ClientHost", ua="[\"request_User-Agent\"]", path="RequestPath", status="DownstreamStatus" | ua=~`(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P).*` | label_format crawler=`{{ if contains "Nexus 5X Build/MMB29P" .ua }}{{ if contains "Googlebot" .ua }}Googlebot{{ else }}Google renderer{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ regexReplaceAll "(?i)^.*?([a-z0-9._-]*(bot|crawler|spider)[a-z0-9._-]*).*$" .ua "${1}" }}{{ end }}` [$__range])))
